desc: WAIT ON DAY LIGHT TO CONT. R/U.
CONT RIG UP & R/U PGO MUD LOGGING. SPUD THE RIG @ 18:00, 17-Mar-2021 AS PER PRE-SPUD CHECK LIST. REQ NIDC TO RUN MAGNET TRIP, NO MAGNET ON RIG SITE.

P/U & M/U 26" M.T.BIT (NEW, VARREL, 115, DRESS W/3*18/32" NZ+ 1*18/32" C.JET) & RIH W/BHA#1 INCLUDE: 9-1/2" B.SUB (FLOAT & BAFFLE PLATE IN)+ 1 JT 9-3/4" DC+ XOS+ 1 JT 5" DP TO 14.5M, TAG GROUND @ THIS POINT.

COMMENCE DRLG 26" HOLE SECTION F/14.5 TO 19.5M W/0-5 KLBS, 30-60 RPM, 200-450 GPM, 100-250 PSI, 0-2 KLB.FT, NL. Note: *** 2 HRS DEDUCTION CONSIDER FOR MUDLOGGING (PGO Co) DUE TO INCORRECT PERFORMANCE OF SENSORS AFTER SPUD THE RIG. *** TANKERS STOPPED DELIVERING WATER TO RIG FROM 1399/12/25. *** THERE IS NO AIR CONDITIONER IN PECO GEOLOGIST, PECO MUD SUPERVISOR AND SERVICE COMPANY ROOMS IN CAMP. *** REC. CEMENT CREW & AIR COMPRESSOR AND PUMP TRUCK. (PDKC Co.) ON LOCATION @ 17-MAR-2021, 08:00. *** ARR. WELLHEAD CREW (MSA Co.) ON LOCATION @ 17-MAR-2021, 09:00. *** REC. CSG RUNNING EQUIP. (NIDC Co.) ON LOCATION @ 17-MAR-2021, 16:00. *** DRILLING CONTRACTOR SHOULD PREPARE 1 LIFT TRUCK. ***  BLACK OUT THE RIG @ 18:30.
DRLG 26" HOLE SECTION F/19.5 TO 21.5M W/0-5 KLBS, 60 RPM, 450 GPM, 250 PSI, 0-2 KLB.FT, AVG ROP: 0.8 MPH, NL.

PUMP HI-VIS PILL, C.B.U TO SHAKERS CLEAN. POOH TO SURFACE & CHECK THE BIT, OBS. BIT PARTIALLY BALLED UP. CLEAN SAME (RECOVER 2 LB JUNK). REQ MAGNET, NO EXIST IN RIG SITE. RIH TO 21.5 M WHILE ADD 1 JT 9 3/4" D.C TO BHA
RESUME DRLG 26" HOLE SECTION F/ 21.5 TO 23 M, NL. AGAIN OBS JUNK INDICATION IN HOLE.
POOH TO SURFACE TO CHECK THE BIT, CLEAN SAME (RECOVER 1 LB JUNK, SEEMS LIKE HOOK & RING). RIH BACK TO BTM
RESUME DRLG 26" H.S F/23 TO 23.5M,  W/0-5 KLBS, 60 RPM, 450 GPM, 250 PSI, 0-2 KLB.FT, AVG ROP: 1 MPH, NL.
SUDDENLY RIG BLACK OUT, WORK ON ELECTRICAL PROBLEMS. POOH TO SURFACE.'FIX ELECTRICAL PROBLEM WHILE CLEAN THE BIT
RIH TO BTM, RESUME DRLG 26" H.S F/ 23 TO 25M W/10 KLBS, 80 RPM, 600 GPM, 400 PSI, 0-2 KLB.FT, AVG ROP: 2 MPH, NL.
NOTICE 2 SHAKERS OUT OF SERVICE, STOP DRLG. POOH TO SURFACE. WORK ON SHAKERS AND FIX SAME WHILE CLEAN THE BIT.
RIH TO BTM, RESUME DRLG 26" H.S F/ 25 TO 29 M W/10 KLBS, 85 RPM, 650 GPM, 400 PSI, 0-2 KLB.FT, AVG ROP: 2 MPH, NL.
PUMP HI-VIS PILL, C.B.U TO SHAKERS CLEAN. POOH TO SURFACE & CHECK THE BIT,CLEAN SAME. RIH TO BTM WHILE ADD 1 JT 9 3/4" D.C TO BHA.
RESUME DRLG 26" H.S F/ 29 TO 38 M W/10-15 KLBS, 85 RPM, 700-800 GPM, 700-750 PSI, 0-2 KLB.FT, AVG ROP: 3 MPH, NL.
PUMP HI-VIS PILL, C.B.U TO SHAKERS CLEAN. POOH TO 19 M. RIH TO BTM WHILE ADD  26" S. STABILIZER (1/16" U.GAUGE) @ 20M + 1 JT 9 3/4" D.C TO BHA.
RESUME DRLG 26" H.S F/ 38 TO  45.5 M W/15-20 KLBS, 70-90 RPM, 800-900 GPM, 700-900 PSI, 0-2 KLB.FT, AVG ROP: 3 MPH, NL.
DRLG 26" H.S F/ 45.5 TO  52.5 M W/15-20 KLBS, 70-90 RPM, 850 GPM, 900 PSI, 1-2 KLB.FT, AVG ROP: 4.5 MPH, NL.
PUMP HI-VIS PILL, C.B.U TO SHAKERS CLEAN. POOH TO  43 M. RIH BACK TO BTM WHILE ADD 1 JT 9 3/4" D.C TO BHA
RESUME DRLG 26" H.S F/ 52.5 TO 62 M W/15-20 KLBS, 70-90 RPM, 800-900 GPM, 700-900 PSI, 1-2 KLB.FT, AVG ROP: 2 MPH, NL.
PUMP HI-VIS PILL, C.B.U TO SHAKERS CLEAN. POOH TO  53 M. RIH BACK TO BTM WHILE ADD 1 JT 9 3/4" D.C TO BHA.
RESUME DRLG 26" H.S F/ 62 TO  67 M W/15-20 KLBS, 80-100 RPM, 800-900 GPM, 800-1000 PSI, 1-3 KLB.FT, AVG ROP: 3 MPH, NL.

CHANGE PUMP, OBS. ABNORMAL PRESS (600 PSI OVER), TRY TO NORMALIZE BY JERKING AND RELEASING PRESS SEVERAL TIMES, NO SUCCESS. IN ORDER TO RECTIFY PROBLEM, POOH TO SURFACE, NOTHING OBSERVED. FLUSH THE BIT, BHA & STANDPIPE.
M/U 26" M.T.BIT & SAME BHA#1 & RIH TO 45M, BREAK CIRC & FLUSH STRING, OBS NORMAL PRESSURE.

WAIT ON REC. NIDC SHAKER REPAIR TEAM AND EQUIPMENT WHILE SLOW CIRC. THRU STRING @ 45M WITH NORMAL PRESS. REPAIR SHAKER TEAM ARRIVED @ 21:00. WORK ON SHAKERS IS ONGOING @ M.N. ***  RIG BLACK OUT @ 05:45. *** 1 LOAD CMT IS NEEDED AS PER PROGRAM.
WAIT ON  RECTIFYING SHAKERS PROBLEM  MEANWHILE SLOW CIRC. THRU STRING@ 45M WITH NORMAL PRESS, NL.
RIH TO BTM, RESUME DRLG 26" H.S F/ 67 TO 75M W/20-25 KLBS, 80-100 RPM, 750-800 GPM, 950-1000 PSI, 1-2 KLB.FT, AVG ROP: 2 MPH, NL.
SUDDENLY BRAKE & EMERGENCY FAILED AND HOOK, BLOCK & TDS SLACK OFF ON STRING. STOP OPERATION AND POOH TO CHECK STRING WHILE CHANGE 2 JT's 5" DP's  & RECTIFY PROBLEM. RIH TO BTM.

RESUME DRLG 26" H.S F/ 75 TO 103M W/20-28 KLBS, 80-90 RPM, 800-850 GPM, 900-950 PSI, 1-2 KLB.FT, AVG ROP: 3 MPH, NL. OFFLINE OPERATION: CONNECT SIDE OUTLET G.VALVES OF C.H.H AND TEST SAME BY WELL HEAD SPECIALIST.
CONT. DRLG 26" H.S F/ 103 TO 150 M (CSG POINT) W/20-28 KLBS, 80-100 RPM, 800-850 GPM, 900-950 PSI, 1-2 KLB.FT, AVG ROP: 3-4 MPH, NL.
PUMP 40 BBL HI VIS PILL & CBU TILL CLEAN SHAKERS WHILE RECIPROCATE STRING, NL.
POOH ON ELEVATOR F/150 TO 60M, RIH BACK TO BTM @ 150M AS CONDITION TRIP W/GOOD HOLE CONDITION.

CBU, SPOT 100 BBL HI VIS PILL, DROP TATCO, POOH TO SURFACE WHILE RACK BACK DP STD & BHA, L/D 26" S.STAB & 26" M.T.BIT#1 AND CLEAN SAME. (BIT CONDITION: 1-1-WT-A-E-IG-NO-TD). RETRIEVE TOTCO, 0 DEG IN 150M.
CLEAR RIG FLOOR, RIG UP STAB IN BOARD, CHANGE TDS LINK W/LONGER ONE, RIG UP CSG RUNNING EQUIPMENTS.
CONT. RIG UP 20" CSG RUNNING EQUIPMENTS.
HELD PJSM,  P/U 20",133#  J-55, BTC SHOE JT WHILE WELDED STAB IN TYPE  FLOAT SHOE ON IT,  F/U SHOE JT & INSTALL CENTRALIZER, P/U & M/U  2nd JT 20" CSG 133# J-55 BTC AND RIH TO 23M.  M/U CIRC SWAGE.
WORK ON CONNECT F/UP HOSE SEVERAL TIMES, OK.
ESTABLISH CIRC & CHECK FLOAT SHOE FUNCTION, OK. B/O CIRC SWAGE. RESUME RIH 20" CSG F/ 23 TO 80 M (TOTALLY 7 JT's), F/U EACH JT, INSTALL CENTRALIZER AS PER PROGRAM.
TRY TO M/U 8TH JTS OF 20" CSG 133#, J-55, BTC SEVERAL TIMES, NO SUCCESS. OBS BOX THREAD OF  7TH JTS 20" CSG 133#, J-55, BTC DAMAGED. L/D SAME.
RESUME RIH 20" CSG 133#, J-55, BTC F/ 70 TO 150M WHILE WASH DOWN LAST 2M AND CONFIRM SECTION TD W/ 15 KLBS, FILL UP EVERY JTS AND INSTALL CENTRALIZER AS PER TALLY.
CONT. CIRC. WHILE MADE CMT SOLUTION AND 3 STD 5" DP W/ NL.

B/O AND L/D CIRC. SWAGE, P/U & M/U 5" STINGER & RIH W/ 5" DP PUP JT 10 FT (INSTALL 20" x 5" BOW CENTRALIZER AT 3M) + 5" DP PUP JT 15 FT + 5 STD 5" DP TO 150M. STING IN STINGER INSIDE STAB IN TYPE 20" FLOAT SHOE. FIX STRING W/ AIR HOISTS. STABLISH CIRC. AND INCREASE FLOW RATE TO 210 GPM (CMT PUMPING RATE) WHILE MONITOR 20" x 5" ANN, STATIC.
L/U CMT TRUCK TO STRING & PRESS TEST LINE TO 300 / 2000 PSI, 10 MIN, OK. PUMP 40 BBL FRESH WATER AS SPACER  BY RIG PUMP.

MIXED AND PUMP 780 SXS CMT "G" DELIJAN (S.W. : 118 PCF, S.V.: 185 BBL) AND DISPLACE W/ 7 BBL MUD (GET CONTAMINATED MUD AFTER PUMP 135 BBL CMT AND GET CMT SLURRY ON SHAKERS AFTER PUMP 175 BBL CMT). CHECK BACK FLOW, OK.
STING OUT STINGER & POOH 3 STDs 5" DP & FLUSH THE STRING. POOH TO SURFACE & L/D 5" STINGER (W/ GOOD CONDITION).
WOC TO SURFACE SAMPLE GET HARD. *** SURFACE SAMPLE 50% HARD AT M.N.***
CONT. WOC, SURFACE SAMPLE GET HARD AFTER 6 HRS.
OPEN WINDOW ON CONDUCTOR PIPE,MADE SMALL HOLE ON 20" CASING BODY & WAIT TO DRAIN MUD OF INSIDE CASING.
ROUGH CUT 20" CSG, IN ORDER TO B/O L.JOINT, CHANGE RIG TONG, B/O LANDING JOINT FROM CUT OF JOINT & L/D SAME.
ROUGH CUT C.PIPE AND L/D SAME. FINAL CUT 20" CSG NECK, BEVEL AND DRESS SAME SEVERAL TIMES & CHECK CSG NECK LEVEL, OK.
N/U & WELDING 21 1/4" 2K C.H.H WELDED TYPE ON CSG NECK WHILE WARM UP CHH BODY BEFORE WELDING,
WAIT ON COOLING CHH,PRESS TEST CHH UP TO 500 PSI / 10 MIN, OK.
N/U 21-1/4'' 2K x 21-1/4'' 2K DSA TIE DOWN + 21-1/4", 2K DRILLING SPOOL,  N/U 21 1/4" 2K ANNULAR PREVENTER IN PROGRESS.

CONT. N/U 21 1/4" 2K ANNULAR PREVENTER, N/U BELL NIPPLE. WELDING 4" CHOKE LINE AND CONNECT BOP TO CHOKE MANIFOLD. CONNECT HYDRAULIC LINES OF ANNULAR PREVENTER & 2" & 4" HCR VALVE  TO ACCUMULATOR UNIT.
WORK ON RELATED LINES CONNECTION, ACCUMULATOR UNIT AND BOP REMOTE PANELS.

PERFORM BOP PRESSURE TEST AS PER POLICY WITH 1000 PSI,10 MIN, OK. FUNCTION TEST ACCUMULATOR UNIT, OK. FUNCTION TEST BOP REMOTE PANELS, OK. PRESSURE TEST BURNING LINE WITH 1000 PSI, OBS LEAKAGE ON LINE, WELDED LEAKAGE POINT AND FIX SAME, OK.
RETRIEVE PULG TESTER AND SET WEAR BUSHING.
P/U 42 JTs 5" DP JT BY JT (WHILE HAMMERING, WASHING & PASS PROPER RABBIT) AND MAKE 14 STDs 5" DP IN MOUSE HOLE AND R/B TO DERRICK.
CONT. P/U 213 JTs 5" DP JT BY JT  (WHILE HAMMERING, WASHING & PASS PROPER RABBIT) AND MAKE 71 STDs 5" DP (TOTALLY 85 STDs) IN MOUSE HOLE AND R/B TO DERRICK.
CHANGE TDS LINKS.

P/U & M/U 17 1/2" M.T.BIT (NEW, S/N: 5207208, 114, 4 x 20/32", BAKER HUGHES) + 9 3/4" B.SUB (W/ FLOAT VALVE & TOTCO BAFFLE) + 2 JTS 9 3/4" DC + 17 1/2" S.STABILIZER @ 20M ( 1/32" UNDER GAUGE) + 4 JTS 9 3/4" DC + XOS + 3 JTS 8 1/2" DC (JT BY JT) TO 87 M TAKE WEIGHT.

L/D 1 JT 8 1/2" DC, P/U 5" DP STD & M/U TDS. TRY TO WASH DOWN NO SUCCESS. PASS THIS POINT W/ROTATION, RIH WITH WASH DOWN TO 98 M. TAKE WEIGHT, TRY TO  WASH DOWN NO SUCCESS, PASS THIS POINT W/ROTATION & CONT. WASH DOWN TO 135 M. POOH 2 STDs 5" DP F/ 135M TO 80M AND CHECK INTERVAL WITHOUT PUMPING & ROTATION, OK.
CONT. M/U BHA: 1 JT 8 1/2" DC + 8" D.JAR (PASS 2-1/2" RABBIT) + 3 JTS 8 1/2" DC (JT BY JT) + XOS  & RIH TO 127 M. P/U 5" DP STD & M/U TDS, RIH W/ WASH DOWN TO 148M. TAG TOC @ THIS POINT.

COMMENCE D/O HARD CMT & 20" CSG SHOE TO 150 M. DRESS & SMOOTH 20" CSG SHOE SEVERAL TIMES AND CHECK IT SAME, OK. CONFIRM 20" CSG SHOE AT 150M.  'D/O PARAMETERS: WOB 1-3 KLBS, RPM 40-50, GPM 350, SPP 150-200 PSI, TRQ 0-2 KFT.LB.

COMMENCE DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 150M TO 172M WITH LOW PARAMETERS TILL S.STABILIZER OUT OF 20" CSG SHOE. PUMP HI-VIS PILL DRILLED EVERY JTS.  ' DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 15-20 KLBS, RPM 60-80, GPM 350-500, SPP 150-300 PSI, TRQ 2-4 KFT.LB. ROP 4.4 M/HR.
CONT DRLG 17 1/2" H.S.  F/ 172 TO 185M. PUMP HI-VIS PILL AFTER DRILLED EVERY JTS. W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 15-25 KLBS, RPM 80-100, GPM 500-750, SPP 300-750 PSI, TRQ 2-4 KFT.LB, ROP 8.7 M/HR.

SUDDENLY BLACK OUT THE RIG. ESTABLISH RIG POWER, NOTICE  TDS WAS OUT OF SERVICE, WHILE CIRC. THRU STRING WORK ON TDS, NO SUCCESS. PUMP HI-VIS PILL & CBU TO CLEAN THE HOLE, POOH F/ 185 M TO 145 M INSIDE 20" CSG  W/ GOOD HOLE CONDITION. CONT. WORK ON TDS ELECTRICAL MALFUNCTION MEANWHILE SLOW CIRC. THRU STRING W/ NL-NG.
CONT. WORK ON TDS ELECTRICAL MALFUNCTION & FIX IT SAME, MEANWHILE SLOW CIRC. THRU STRING W/ NL-NG. RIH BACK TO BTM W/ GOOD HOLE CONDITION. CHECK TDS, OK.
MAKE CONNECTION.
RESUME DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 185 M TO 214 M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AFTER DRILLED EVERY JT, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 15-25 KLBS, RPM 100, GPM 750, SPP 750 PSI, TRQ 2-3 KFT.LB, ROP 7.25 M/HR.
B/R AND R/D LAST JT DRILLED, MAKE NEW CONNECTION.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 214 M TO 243 M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AFTER DRILLED EVERY JT, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 20-25 KLBS, RPM 110, GPM 800-850, SPP 1000-1050 PSI, TRQ 2-3 KFT.LB, ROP 9.7 M/HR.
B/R AND R/D LAST JT DRILLED, MAKE NEW CONNECTION.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 243 M TO 272 M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AFTER DRILLED EVERY JT, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 20-25 KLBS, RPM 110, GPM 800-850, SPP 1000-1050 PSI, TRQ 2-3 KFT.LB, ROP 11.6 M/HR.
IN ORDER TO SERVICE TDS STOP DRLG. POOH F/ 272 M TO 145 M (INSIDE 20" CSG SHOE).
WORK ON TDS ELECTRICAL SYSTEM AND FIX SAME. MEANWHILE SLOW CIRC. THRU STRING W/ NL-NG.
RIH BACK TO BTM AT 272 M. AND MAKE CONNECTION.
RESUME DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 272 M TO 301 M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AFTER DRILLED EVERY JT, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 20-25 KLBS, RPM 110, GPM 800-850, SPP 1000-1050 PSI, TRQ 2-3 KFT.LB, ROP 5.8 M/HR.
B/R AND R/D LAST JT DRILLED, MAKE NEW CONNECTION.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 301 M TO 330  M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AFTER DRILLED EVERY JT, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 20-25 KLBS, RPM 110, GPM 800-850, SPP 1000-1050 PSI, TRQ 1-3 KFT.LB, ROP 7.25 M/HR.
B/R AND R/D LAST JT DRILLED, MAKE NEW CONNECTION.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 330 M TO 358  M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AFTER DRILLED EVERY JT, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 20-25 KLBS, RPM 110, GPM 800-850, SPP 1000-1050 PSI, TRQ 1-3 KFT.LB, ROP 7 M/HR.
B/R AND R/D LAST JT DRILLED, MAKE NEW CONNECTION.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 358 M TO 387 M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AFTER DRILLED EVERY JT, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 20-30 KLBS, RPM 110, GPM 800-850, SPP 1000-1050 PSI, TRQ 2-3 KFT.LB, ROP 8.3 M/HR.
B/R AND R/D LAST JT DRILLED, MAKE NEW CONNECTION.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 387 M TO 417 M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AFTER DRILLED EVERY JT, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 20-30 KLBS, RPM 110, GPM 800-850, SPP 1000-1050 PSI, TRQ 2-3 KFT.LB, ROP 7.5 M/HR.
B/R AND R/D LAST JT DRILLED, MAKE NEW CONNECTION.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 417 M TO 426 M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AFTER DRILLED EVERY JT, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 20-30 KLBS, RPM 110, GPM 800-850, SPP 1000-1050 PSI, TRQ 2-3 KFT.LB, ROP 4.5 M/HR.
DUE TO LOW R.O.P AND BIT BALLED UP PUMP & SPOT 40 BBL SALT WATER WHILE RECIPROCATE STRING.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 426 M TO 446 M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AFTER DRILLED EVERY JT, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 25-30 KLBS, RPM 110, GPM 800-850, SPP 1000-1050 PSI, TRQ 2-4 KFT.LB, ROP 10 M/HR.
B/R AND R/D LAST JT DRILLED, MAKE NEW CONNECTION.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 446 M TO 456 M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AFTER DRILLED EVERY JT, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 25-30 KLBS, RPM 110, GPM 800-850, SPP 1000-1050 PSI, TRQ 2-4 KFT.LB, ROP 10 M/HR.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 456 M TO 467 M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AFTER DRILLED EVERY JT, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 25-30 KLBS, RPM 110, GPM 800-850, SPP 1000-1100 PSI, TRQ 2-3 KFT.LB, ROP 5.5 M/HR.
DUE TO LOW R.O.P AND BIT BALLED UP PUMP & SPOT 40 BBL SALT WATER WHILE RECIPROCATE STRING.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 467 M TO 475 M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AFTER DRILLED EVERY JT, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 25-30 KLBS, RPM 110, GPM 800-850, SPP 1000-1100 PSI, TRQ 2-3 KFT.LB, ROP 8 M/HR.
B/R AND R/D LAST JT DRILLED, MAKE NEW CONNECTION.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 475 M TO 504 M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AFTER DRILLED EVERY JT, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 25-30 KLBS, RPM 110, GPM 800-850, SPP 1050-110 PSI, TRQ 2-3.5 KFT.LB, ROP 6 M/HR.
B/R AND R/D LAST DRILLED JT, MAKE NEW CONNECTION.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 504 M TO 533 M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AFTER DRILLED STD, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 25-30 KLBS, RPM 110, GPM 800-850, SPP 1050-1150 PSI, TRQ 2-4 KFT.LB, ROP 6.5 M/HR.
B/R AND R/D LAST DRILLED STD, MAKE NEW CONNECTION.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 533 M TO 562 M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AFTER DRILLED STD, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 25-30 KLBS, RPM 110, GPM 800-850, SPP 1050-1200 PSI, TRQ 2-4 KFT.LB, ROP 7.25 M/HR.
B/R AND R/D LAST DRILLED STD, MAKE NEW CONNECTION.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 562 M TO 591 M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AFTER DRILLED STD, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 25-35 KLBS, RPM 110, GPM 800-850, SPP 1100-1200 PSI, TRQ 2-4 KFT.LB, ROP 6.5 M/HR.
B/R AND R/D LAST DRILLED STD, MAKE NEW CONNECTION.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 591 M TO 601 M, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 25-35 KLBS, RPM 110, GPM 800-850, SPP 1150-1200 PSI, TRQ 2-4 KFT.LB, ROP 5 M/HR.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 601 M TO 622 M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AT END OF STD, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 25-35 KLBS, RPM 120, GPM 900-950, SPP 1600-1650 PSI, TRQ 2-4 KFT.LB, ROP 7 M/HR.
B/R AND R/D LAST DRILLED STD, MAKE NEW CONNECTION.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 622 M TO 650 M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AT END OF STD, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 25-35 KLBS, RPM 120, GPM 900-950, SPP 1600-1650 PSI, TRQ 2-4 KFT.LB, ROP 6.2 M/HR.
B/R AND R/D LAST DRILLED STD, MAKE NEW CONNECTION.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 650 M TO 679 M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AT END OF STD, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 25-35 KLBS, RPM 120, GPM 900-950, SPP 1600-1650 PSI, TRQ 2-4 KFT.LB, ROP 6.5 M/HR.
B/R AND R/D LAST DRILLED STD, MAKE NEW CONNECTION.
CONT. DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 679 M TO 707 M, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 25-35 KLBS, RPM 120, GPM 900-950, SPP 1600-1650 PSI, TRQ 2-4 KFT.LB, ROP 6.2 M/HR.
PUMP 40 BBL HI-VIS PILL AND PERFORM CBU TO SHAKERS CLEAN WHILE RECIPROCATE STRING, W/ NL-NG.
B/R LAST 3 STDs F/ 707 M TO 622 M & R/D TO BTM.
PUMP 40 BBL HI-VIS PILL AND PERFORM CBU TO SHAKERS CLEAN WHILE RECIPROCATE STRING, W/ NL-NG.
IN ORDER TO TAKE SURVEY POOH F/ 707 M TO 679 M DROP TOTCO.

POOH F/ 679 M TO 622 M (2 STDs) ON ELEVATOR W/ GOOD HOLE CONDITION. OBSERVE 30-40 KLBS OVER PULL AT 622 M. M/U TDS, PERFORM CIRC. AND B/R FROM 622 M TO 175M. CONT. POOH TO 127 M, (INSIDE 20" CSG) WHILE OBSERVE THE WELL STATIC.
POOH F/ 127 M TO SURFACE, OBSERVE S.STABILIZER & BIT WAS BALLED UP. L/D 17 1/2" M.T.BIT (BIT CONDITION: 1-1-WT-A-E-I-NO-HR). RECORD TOTCO SURVEY 1 DEG DEVIATION AT 679 M.

P/U & M/U NEW 17 1/2" M.T.BIT (S/N: 12142074, 115, 3 x 20/32" + 1 x 18/32" C.J, HALLIBURTON) + 9 3/4" B.SUB (W/ FLOAT VALVE & TOTCO BAFFLE) + 2 JTS 9 3/4" DC + 17 1/2" S.STABILIZER AT 20M ( 1/32" UNDER GAUGE) + 4 JTS 9 3/4" DC + XOS + 1 STD 8 1/2" DC + 8" D.JAR + 1 STD 8 1/2" DC + XOS AND RIH BHA TO 127 M.
FOLLOW BHA BY 5" DP STDs & RIH F/ 127 M TO BTM AT 707 M W/ GOOD HOLE CONDITION.
PERFORM CIRC. W/ P.H.B. MUD AND DUMP RETURN. PUMP 30 BBL HI-VIS PILL AND THE 30 BBL DRILL WATER AS SPACER, START DISPLACE THE WELL W/ 75 PCF SALT POLYMER MUD AND DUMP P.H.B. RETURN MUD.

WARM UP THE BIT AND RESUME DRLG 17 1/2" H.S. F/ 707 M TO 736 M, PUMP HI-VIS PILL AT END OF STD, W/ NL-NG. DRLG PARAMETERS: WOB 5-30 KLBS, RPM 90-120, GPM 800-850, SPP 1300-1350 PSI, TRQ 2-3 KFT.LB, ROP 6.4 M/HR.
